transcriptions.text: Thank you for coming in today, Mrs. Peterson.
I wanted to discuss Jake's progress.
His student ID is 847392, and according to
his IEP from last year, he needs
extended time on tests due to his ADHD diagnosis.
I also noticed from his medical file that
he takes Adderall at noon, which is why
he visits the nurse's office daily.
